label: try T53, a labelled in-sample diagnostic, never an adoption result: M1 (with R1, R2 and g_mom's factors, the entry's form) with its Feng direction zone-fixed (zlv: the cardiomyocyte group's LV-zone direction; zw: every group's E14.5 mean taken at its E9.5 zone shares), raw and slope-matched to the entry's, at the step and twice the step, with permuted controls of the slope-matched forms, on T44's and T46's routes (both E10.5 cuts, the chamber cut also library by library); Feng's E9.5 cells lie inside these pseudo-tasks' external windows and the cuts are ones earlier T1 choices were made on; the result can only go to the team captain
choices: The size-alone figure's multiple is the recorded slope for an arm at the entry's fraction and twice the slope for an _x2 arm; it is not computed outside the uniform arms' multiples 1 to 2.
Slopes and the size-alone figure are per group: the route gives no covered-cell weights.
Labels on each library truth: T46's single-task test of each arm against its comparison arm (ahead, behind, level).
A statistics key without exactly the four parts stage|zone|cell type|half is refused (the run stops).

A form changes a group when its direction's sha256 differs from the entry's; slope-matching and the controls touch changed groups only, and the slope-matched direction is the whole vector divided by s_g.

zw weighs the zones holding any of the group's E9.5 cells; a group keeps the entry's direction when the dropped share is strictly above 0.5; both ends' means are taken over the kept zones with the same renormalised weights (the E9.5 side leaves out the dropped zones' cells, not the entry's pooled E9.5 mean as the amendment worded it).

A control equals the entry's direction outside the moved genes; its permutation runs on the reference role's gene order with the board's panel as the scored stratum (as T46's placebo), one generator per build seed on [build seed, 53], shared over zlv's control then zw's.
The gene statement's test is the adoption rule on both cuts with the control as the base arm.

'Equal size' in the statement is equal size along the entry's direction only; each changed group's 1/s, the slope-matched form's squared size ratio and the size-alone figure at the multiple 1/s (2/s for an _x2 arm, per group, not computed outside 1 to 2) are printed beside it and read by nothing.

A slope refusal refuses the whole run (both forms), as the amendment fixes it, and writes a task file holding the raw forms' record and the refused groups' slopes; the read is then void with 'not read; the form is nearly orthogonal to the entry's direction'.

Information only, read by nothing: each direction's slope on the mean-centred moved genes; each control's slope on the entry's per seed and group; the split-half reliability (N48's formula) of the entry and of each changed group's raw form, each half's zw over the full form's kept zones with that half's own E9.5 shares; whether _F_sm and _F_x2 are the same build (prediction sha256 equal on every seed of a truth).
